paper_title: Constraining axion-like particles using the white dwarf initial-final mass relation
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 as plotted on the y-axis of Figure 1
notes: Paper derives a new stellar-evolution exclusion ('WD-IFMR') on the ALP-photon coupling for keV-MeV masses using the white dwarf initial-final mass relation from double WD binaries, targeting the 'cosmological triangle'. No numerical table is given; the exclusion is presented in Figures 1/15. Data points are reconstructed from explicit text statements: at ma=10 keV, gaγγ ≥ 0.794e-10 GeV^-1 is excluded; at ma=316 keV, gaγγ=3.16e-9 GeV^-1 lies at/inside the excluded set (unconstrained by HB stars but flattens the IFMR beyond the DWD bound); at ma≈630 keV, gaγγ=1e-5 GeV^-1 (inside the cosmological triangle) is excluded — this last point lies within the excluded region rather than exactly on the boundary. The constraint also has an UPPER gaγγ boundary where the ALP decay length falls below the He-burning shell width (~0.007 R_sun), which is not captured in these points. Digitization of Fig. 15 would be needed for a precise boundary. Astrophysical bound: no local DM density assumption.
